options.label: A very strong base like NaNH₂, and no EWG activation on the ring
Strong EWGs ortho/para to the halide (same conditions as SNAr)
A radical initiator and photolysis to initiate the chain
A weak base and polar protic solvent to stabilize the carbanion intermediate

explanation: Benzyne needs STRONG base (NaNH₂, LDA, t-BuOK) to deprotonate ortho to the halide, then eliminate X⁻ → benzyne (strained triple-bond-like intermediate). Then Nu adds to either sp carbon → mixture of products. SNAr needs EWG activation; benzyne needs NO activation (just strong base).
